projects.title: Reel Pick
projects.summary: A movie recommender app: pick the genres and kinds of film you love, and NLP + machine learning surface similar titles and hidden gems. Built with Python, Pandas and Streamlit.
projects.description: Discover your next favourite film with recommendations tailored to your taste. Select the genres and movie types you love, and the system, powered by Natural Language Processing and Machine Learning, analyses your preferences to suggest similar titles and hidden gems just for you.
projects.enemy: Endless scrolling through streaming catalogues without finding anything worth watching.
projects.victory: A Streamlit app that turns a few genre picks into a ranked list of similar titles and hidden gems.

projects.title: Calmly
projects.short: AI-powered mental health tracker with Gemini insights.
projects.summary: Mood logging, journaling and personalised AI insights on a React + FastAPI + PostgreSQL stack.
projects.description: A full-stack, AI-driven mental health platform where users log moods, journal their thoughts and receive personalised insights powered by Google Gemini. A responsive React frontend with interactive dashboards and wellness tools talks to a FastAPI backend and PostgreSQL database, with JWT authentication and encrypted storage.
projects.enemy: Moods and journal entries scattered across apps, with no way to see patterns over time.
projects.victory: One dashboard for moods, journals and wellness tools, with Gemini-generated insights and JWT-secured, encrypted storage.

projects.title: VoyageX
projects.short: AI travel planner: Gemini itineraries, Firebase backend.
projects.summary: A cross-platform React Native app that generates AI itineraries with Gemini.
projects.description: A cross-platform travel app that generates AI-powered itineraries using the Gemini API. Firebase handles user authentication and cloud storage, with trip data managed as JSON. The UI covers trip creation, destination discovery and itinerary review in an intuitive, responsive flow.
projects.enemy: Planning a trip means juggling dozens of tabs to stitch an itinerary together.
projects.victory: A cross-platform app that drafts a full AI itinerary from a destination and preferences, with trips saved to the cloud.

projects.title: Recipe App
projects.short: Jetpack Compose recipe browser on the MealDB API.
projects.summary: A Kotlin + Jetpack Compose app with MVVM, Retrofit and Coil.
projects.description: A modern recipe app built with Jetpack Compose that fetches meals from the MealDB API and shows them in a LazyVerticalGrid for smooth, efficient browsing. Retrofit handles networking, Coil loads images, and the app follows MVVM with Navigation Compose for seamless screen transitions.
projects.enemy: Finding a meal idea fast on a phone, without wading through slow, cluttered pages.
projects.victory: A native Compose app with a smooth image grid, MVVM state handling and seamless navigation between meals.
